content.text:
Here’s what was implemented:

### Traject review (`TrajectRequestReviewFlow.tsx`)
- Removed the Begeleidende brief textarea, sessionStorage helpers, and `continue`-button check tied to the note.
- The screen always shows **Overzicht aanvragen** (matrix for all drafts, including non–product-bound), **Nog certificatie toevoegen**, and **`ProductDocumentationLibrary` only when there are product‑gebonden drafts** (same dependency on real products as before).
- Unified title/description toward “controle aanvraagpakket” before triage.

### Informational intake (`InfoRequestPlaceholderPage.tsx`)
- On mount: **`api.unlockSubmissionNoteFromInformationalPath()`** — flips **`submissionNoteUnlocked`** so the note can also appear later on nazicht.
- Adds an optional **Begeleidende toelichting** block (same `ProductRequestNoteField`, long limit), bound to **`api.setSubmissionNote`** (persisted in onboarding flow state).

### Flow state & API (`onboarding-types`, `onboarding-default-flow-state`, `onboarding-flow-api`)
- **`submissionNote`** (default `''`) and optional **`submissionNoteUnlocked`**.
- New **`unlockSubmissionNoteFromInformationalPath`** and **`setSubmissionNote`** on `OnboardingFlowApi`.

### Summary step (`OnboardingSummaryStep.tsx` + plumbing)
- When **`submissionNoteUnlocked`** (user has opened the informational flow in this persisted session), shows the **same optional note**, editable via **`setFlowState`**, above **Volledig pakketoverzicht**.
- **`buildFullOnboardingPackageEntityRecords`** appends a **Begeleidende toelichting** row when the trimmed note is non-empty so it appears in the full-package table before submit.

### Other
- **`use-onboarding-flow`**, **`onboarding-flow-view-props`**, **`use-onboarding-registration-layout-model`**, and **`baseOnboardingFlowViewProps` / seed** wired for **`submissionNote`** / **`submissionNoteUnlocked`**.
- Comment-only update in **`TrajectConfigureFlow.tsx`** so it matches the new review behaviour.

Formal-only onboarding (never opening `/welcome/info-request/...`) stays **without** this note block on nazicht by design so the capability stays tied to the informational path first, while users who unlocked it can still edit the same text when they proceed to a formal dossier summary.
